summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs MarketBeta U.S. 1000 Equity ETF (GUSA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive GBS United States 1000 index. The fund tracks an index of 1,000 US large-cap companies selected and weighted by market-cap. GUSA was launched on Apr 5, 2022 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.

holdings.infoBox: GUSA is an equity ETF with a total of 1006 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.35%, Apple at 6.75%, Alphabet at 5.23%, Microsoft at 5.13%, and Amazon.com at 3.37%.
